To Debate in 2028, Democrats Will Have to Disavow Dark Money

The Democratic National Committee (DNC) on Monday announced plans for 12 debates in the 2028 Democratic presidential primary, beginning in June 2027. The framework, released earlier than usual, includes a new requirement: To qualify for the debates, candidates must sign a pledge to denounce certain outside spending.
